data.name: Mahsum
data.gender_notes: Mahsum is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahsoum' which means 'forgiven' or 'sinless'. This name is often used to describe individuals who have been granted forgiveness by Allah, and is a reminder of the importance of seeking forgiveness and living a righteous life. The name Mahsum carries the meaning “Forgiven, Sinless” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahsum usually hope their child will grow to embody forgiven, sinless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the forgiveness and mercy of Allah.
data.etymology: Mahsum belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgiven, Sinless.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahsum total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone who is not only protected but also endowed with determination and firmness in their actions and decisions.
